en: The BukSU CAT is the Bukidnon State University College Admission Test.
It is a mandatory exam for all incoming first year college students and second coursers who want to enroll in undergraduate programs.
ceb: Ang BukSU CAT mao ang Bukidnon State University College Admission Test.
Kini mandatory nga exam para sa tanang incoming first year students ug second coursers nga gusto mo enroll sa undergraduate programs.

en: How can I take the BukSU College Admission Test?
Follow these steps to apply for the BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Access http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Register using your active Gmail account. Create your password and re-type it for verification.
Step 2: After creating an account, an email containing a confirmation link will be sent to your Gmail. Check your inbox and click the link to activate your account.
Step 3: Fill out all the necessary information and upload the documentary requirements.
Step 4: Select your preferred schedule (venue, date, and time) based on the availability of slots.
Step 5: You will get notifications when your application is accepted. Once accepted, download and print your Test Permit.
ceb: Unsaon nako pagkuha sa BukSU College Admission Test?
Sunod kining mga lakang aron mag-apply sa BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Bisitaha ang http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Mag-register gamit ang imong active nga Gmail account. Himoa ang imong password ug i-type pag-usab para sa verification.
Step 2: Human makahimo og account, usa ka email nga adunay confirmation link ipadala sa imong Gmail. Tan-awa ang imong inbox ug i-klik ang link aron ma-activate ang imong account.
Step 3: Pun-a ang tanan nga kinahanglan nga impormasyon ug i-upload ang mga documentary requirements.
Step 4: Pilia ang imong preferred schedule (venue, petsa, ug oras) base sa available nga slots.
Step 5: Makadawat ka og notifications kung gi-accept ang imong aplikasyon. Kung ma-accept, i-download ug i-print ang imong Test Permit.

en: What to bring on the examination day
Test takers must bring the following items:
1. Test Permit (can be downloaded from the BukSU admission website)
2. Application Form (can be downloaded from the BukSU admission website)
3. Pen
4. Pencil No. 2, eraser, and sharpener

Please be reminded that this is for Admission examination, not for college course examinations. For college course examinations, please refer to the specific requirements provided by your respective colleges.
ceb: Unsa ang dad-on sa adlaw sa examination
Kinahanglan dad-on sa mga test takers ang mosunod:
1. Test Permit (ma-download gikan sa BukSU admission website)
2. Application Form (ma-download gikan sa BukSU admission website)
3. Pen
4. Pencil No. 2, eraser, ug sharpener

Palihog hinumdumi nga kini para sa Admission examination, dili para sa mga college course examinations. Para sa mga college course examinations, palihog tan-awa ang espesipikong mga requirements nga gihatag sa inyong mga respective colleges.

en: If your BukSU CAT test permit is corrupted, invalid, missing, or cannot be opened, log in again to your BukSU Admission account and try downloading the test permit again.
If the downloaded file still does not work, contact or visit the BukSU Admission and Testing Unit for assistance before your exam schedule.
Do not use COR replacement steps for this concern because a test permit is an admission examination document.
ceb: Kung corrupted, invalid, nawala, o dili ma-open ang imong BukSU CAT test permit, login balik sa imong BukSU Admission account ug sulayi pag-download usab ang test permit.
Kung dili gihapon mo-work ang na-download nga file, kontaka o adtoa ang BukSU Admission and Testing Unit para matabangan ka sa dili pa ang imong exam schedule.
Ayaw gamita ang COR replacement steps ani nga concern kay ang test permit kay admission examination document.

en: Are there fees for the College Admission Test?
College Admission Tests are offered for FREE at Bukidnon State University.
However, applicants who have already completed a bachelors degree (second course takers) need to pay 300 Php for the Admission Test.
They are not qualified to avail of the benefits of the Free Higher Education.
ceb: Naay bayad ang College Admission Test?
Ang College Admission Tests libre ra sa Bukidnon State University.
Apan, ang mga aplikante nga nakakompleto na og bachelor's degree (second course takers) kinahanglan magbayad og 300 Php para sa Admission Test.
Dili sila kwalipikado sa mga benepisyo sa Free Higher Education.

en: How and when will I know my examination result?

Examination results will also be posted on your admission account around May to June.

en: The BukSU Entrance Examination cannot be rescheduled once your exam date has been assigned.

I recommend ensuring your availability on your assigned exam date to avoid delays in your admission.

Kung dili ka makatunga sa imong scheduled exam, mahimo nga kinahanglan ka maghulat sa sunod nga admission cycle.
Mas maayo nga siguroon ang imong availability sa imong exam date aron malikayan ang delay sa imong admission.

en: If you miss your scheduled BukSU CAT exam date you should immediately contact the Admission and Testing Unit.

en: Here are the requirements you need before applying for BukSU Admission Testing:
1. You need to have your own personal Gmail account to create an account on BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/

2. You need a digital copy of your 2x2 photo. Please make sure your photo meets the following specifications: plain white background, wearing a white T-shirt, no accessories, and the correct 2x2 size.
For documentary requirements:

Report card, Transcript of Records, Principal’s Certification, GWA, and Diploma. These are optional as long as you have the Principal’s Certification. Make sure it is signed by your principal and properly sealed.
After applying for BukSU Admission, please wait for approval.
Note: Your Gmail should be accessible, as all verification codes will be sent there.
ceb: Ania ang mga kinahanglanon nga imong andamon sa dili pa mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission Testing:
1. Kinahanglan naa kay personal nga Gmail account aron makahimo og account sa BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/

2. Kinahanglan pud ka og digital copy sa imong 2x2 nga litrato. Siguroa nga ang imong litrato mosunod sa mosunod nga specifications: puti nga background, nagsul-ob og puti nga T-shirt, walay accessories, ug sakto nga 2x2 nga size.
Para sa documentary requirements:

Report card, Transcript of Records, Principal’s Certification, GWA, ug Diploma. Optional ra kini basta naa kay Principal’s Certification. Siguroa nga pirmado kini sa imong principal ug sakto ang pag-seal.
Human ka mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission, palihog hulata ang approval.
Note: Siguroa nga ma-access nimo ang imong Gmail, kay didto ipadala ang tanang verification codes.

en: Yes BukSU accepts transferees depending on the availability of slots in the chosen program. You must first take and pass the BukSU Admission before you can enroll as a transferee.
Once you pass the admission, proceed to the BukSU main campus and go to the college department where you plan to enroll.
Transferees must submit an Honorable Dismissal and an Informative Copy of their Transcript of Records for evaluation, meet the required GWA, and pass any admission interview or exam.
Since each department may have its own specific rules for transferees, it is best to ask a faculty or staff member directly in the office for proper guidance.
ceb: Oo, modawat ang BukSU og transferees depende sa available nga slots sa imong pilion nga kurso. Kinahanglan una ka mopasar sa BukSU Admission bago ka maka-enroll isip transferee.
Human nimo makapasar sa admission, adto sa BukSU main campus ug diretso sa college department nga imong gustong enrollan.
Ang transferees kinahanglan mo-submit og Honorable Dismissal ug Informative Copy sa ilang Transcript of Records para sa evaluation, maabot ang required GWA, ug mopasar sa admission interview o exam.
Tungod kay ang matag department adunay kaugalingong mga patakaran para sa transferees, mas maayo nga mangutana diretso sa faculty o staff sa opisina para sa hustong giya ug tabang.

en: Second coursers must submit a Transcript of Records for evaluation a 2x2 ID picture and a payment receipt of 300 pesos for the admission test and they are generally not covered by the Free Higher Education law.
ceb: Ang second courser kinahanglan mag submit og Transcript of Records para sa evaluation 2x2 ID picture ug resibo sa bayad nga 300 pesos para sa admission test ug kasagaran dili na sila sakop sa Free Higher Education law.

en: Yes second coursers may apply for the BukSU CAT.
They are required to pay a 300 peso testing fee and submit their Transcript of Records.
Second coursers are not eligible for the Free Higher Education benefits.

Kinahanglan sila mobayad og 300 pesos nga testing fee ug mag submit sa Transcript of Records.
Dili sila kwalipikado sa libre nga tuition sa Free Higher Education program.

en: Requirements for the Graduate Program Admission Test include a soft copy of a 2x2 ID picture.
You must also submit a scanned copy of your transcript of records.
Non BukSU graduates must submit an honorable dismissal.
A payment receipt is also required.
ceb: Ang mga kinahanglanon sa GPAT naglakip sa soft copy sa 2x2 ID picture.
Kinahanglan usab ang scanned copy sa transcript of records.
Para sa dili BukSU graduates kinahanglan ang honorable dismissal.
Kinahanglan usab ang payment receipt.

en: Applicants for a Masters degree must submit an Honorable Dismissal.
They must provide an original Transcript of Records with the remark Valid for Transfer.
A two by two ID picture is required and applicants must pass the Graduate Program Admission Test.
ceb: Ang mga aplikante sa Masters degree kinahanglan mag submit og Honorable Dismissal.
Kinahanglan usab ang original Transcript of Records nga naay remark nga Valid for Transfer.
Kinahanglan ang duha sa duha nga ID picture ug kinahanglan makapasar sa Graduate Program Admission Test.

en: Applicants for the Juris Doctor program must have a bachelor degree a Transcript of Records and must pass the Law School Admission Test followed by a panel interview.
ceb: Ang mga aplikante sa Juris Doctor kinahanglan adunay bachelor degree Transcript of Records ug kinahanglan makapasar sa Law School Admission Test ug panel interview.

en: Graduates of the Alternative Learning System or ALS are allowed to apply for the BukSU College Admission Test.
Applicants must provide their ALS Certificate of Rating and other required identification documents.
ceb: Ang mga graduate sa Alternative Learning System o ALS mahimong maka apply sa BukSU College Admission Test.

en: For the school year 2020-2021, BukSU-CAT has two rating status: “Passed” or “Failed”.
In order to be enrolled in BukSU, the exam taker must obtain at least 40% (passing rate).
Exam takers who obtained rating below the passing rate will not be admitted.
For board courses like Education, Nursing and Accountancy, their colleges require 50% and above BukSU-CAT rating.
The validity of the exam is for one year.
No retake is allowed within a year from the date of the exam.
HOWEVER this are old data so it might be change in every year, you can directly ask the Public Help Disk which is located on the entrance of BukSU.
ceb: Para sa school year 2020-2021, ang BukSU-CAT adunay duha ka rating status: “Passed” o “Failed”.
Aron maka-enroll sa BukSU, ang exam taker kinahanglan makakuha og labing menos 40% (passing rate).
Ang mga exam taker nga nakakuha og rating ubos sa passing rate dili pasudlon.
Para sa board courses sama sa Education, Nursing, ug Accountancy, ang ilang kolehiyo nagkinahanglan og 50% ug pataas nga BukSU-CAT rating.
Ang validity sa exam kay usa ka tuig lamang.
Dili pwede mag-retake sulod sa usa ka tuig gikan sa petsa sa exam.
BISAN PA, kini daan nga datos ug posibleng mausab matag tuig, mao nga mas maayo nga mangutana diretso sa Public Help Desk nga naa sa entrance sa BukSU.

en: You can get your COR on the Buksu admission website, here is the step by step process of getting your COR
Step1: Go to your Buksu admission, Login using your credentials
Step2: Click on the Enrollment tab, in mobile you can usually found it by clicking the 3 line menu tab at the top left of your screen

you can now proceed to your validation if you're not yet validated.

pwede ka na magpadayon sa imong validation kung wala ka pa na-validate.

en: If you failed your buksu cat examination you still have a choice, you can apply for Affirmative Action Program (AAP) but please note that you cannot choose the courses you want to enroll in, they will be the one choosing your program depends on your capability.
here how you can apply the AAP

1. Monitor Your Results: Check your Report of Rating (ROR) via the BukSU Admissions Portal. Even if you are not on the list of Qualifiers, keep your account credentials. https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
2 Go to the Diversity and Inclusion Unit located at the BukSU Main Campus in Malaybalay City. This unit manages the AAP selection.

3. Submit Supporting Documents: You will need to provide proof of your eligibility, such as:
For IPs: Certificate of Tribal Membership or NCIP Certificate.
For PWDs: Valid PWD ID.
For Low-Income: Certificate of Indigency from your Barangay or ITR of parents.
Academic Records: Your Senior High School Report Card (Form 138).
4. Interview/Evaluation: The Diversity and Inclusion Unit may conduct an interview to assess your academic potential and commitment to finishing the degree.

5. Placement: If approved, you may be offered a slot in a program that still has available capacity (note that highly competitive board courses like Nursing or Accountancy often have stricter cut-offs that AAP cannot always bypass).
ceb: Kung wala ka nakapasar sa BukSU CAT examination, naa gihapon kay laing kapilian—pwede ka mo-apply sa Affirmative Action Program (AAP), apan palihug hinumdumi nga dili ikaw ang mopili sa kurso nga imong enrollan, sila ang mopili base sa imong kapasidad.
Ania kung giunsa pag-apply sa AAP:

1. Bantayi ang imong Resulta: Tan-awa ang imong Report of Rating (ROR) pinaagi sa BukSU Admissions Portal. Bisan dili ka apil sa listahan sa Qualifiers, i-keep ang imong account credentials. https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
2. Adto sa Diversity and Inclusion Unit nga nahimutang sa BukSU Main Campus sa Malaybalay City. Kini nga unit ang nagdumala sa AAP selection.

3. I-submit ang Supporting Documents: Kinahanglan nimo ipakita ang pruweba sa imong eligibility, sama sa:
Para sa IPs: Certificate of Tribal Membership o NCIP Certificate.
Para sa PWDs: Valid PWD ID.
Para sa Low-Income: Certificate of Indigency gikan sa inyong Barangay o ITR sa ginikanan.
Academic Records: Senior High School Report Card (Form 138).
4. Interview/Evaluation: Ang Diversity and Inclusion Unit mahimong mag-conduct og interview aron masusi ang imong academic potential ug commitment sa paghuman sa degree.

5. Placement: Kung ma-aprubahan, mahimo kang hatagan og slot sa usa ka programa nga naa pay available nga kapasidad (hinumdumi nga ang highly competitive nga board courses sama sa Nursing o Accountancy kasagaran adunay mas istrikto nga cut-offs nga dili permi malabwan sa AAP).
